risks.reasoning: For the nine months ended September 30, 2021, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash flows from operating activities of RMB38,538 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period of RMB274,169 thousand. Because net cash from operating activities is positive, the frozen protocol rule treats the period as having no operating cash burn; no cash runway is calculated.

The accountants' report shows profit for the year/period of RMB17,487 thousand, RMB22,624 thousand, RMB77,124 thousand, RMB53,329 thousand and RMB109,351 thousand for 2018, 2019, 2020, 9M2020 and 9M2021 respectively. There are zero comparable loss periods, so the continuous-loss condition is not met.
Audited revenue increased from RMB665,322 thousand in 9M2020 to RMB1,048,685 thousand in 9M2021, an increase of approximately 57.62%. The frozen negative-growth thresholds are not triggered.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2021, the single largest customer (Sinochem Group and its subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates, including China Jinmao) contributed 46.1% of total revenue and the five largest customers contributed 50.4% in aggregate. The largest-customer share exceeds the frozen 30% medium threshold but remains below 50%; the top-five share remains below the 60% medium threshold.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2021, the single largest supplier accounted for 23.9% and the five largest suppliers accounted for 37.1% of total purchases. Both disclosed ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%, respectively.

The corporate history and reorganization disclosure shows the Company was incorporated as a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Jinmao and that capital contributions were made by China Jinmao without allotment or issuance of new shares. No external pre-IPO investor holding redemption, repurchase, put or other restorable special rights was identified.

The formal Legal Proceedings and Compliance section states that as of the Latest Practicable Date there were no litigation, arbitration or administrative proceedings pending or threatened which would have a material adverse effect, and that the Group had no material non-compliance incidents with material financial or operational impact. The disclosed non-compliances, including failure to file brokerage licenses and a RMB3.05 million electricity-pricing fine, were remediated, immaterial in amount or revenue impact, and did not remain pending.

The formal Business overview describes the Group as a fast-growing upscale property management and city operation service provider with revenue of RMB1,048.7 million in 9M2021. Its core services are already commercialized and revenue-generating; it is not a precommercial product-development issuer.

evidence.exact_text: As advised by our PRC Legal Advisers, as of the Latest Practicable Date, we had obtained all material permits, licenses, registrations and filings necessary to conduct our business operations during the Track Record Period from the relevant government authorities, all of which are valid and in force, and we had been in compliance in all material respects with the applicable PRC laws and regulations.

evidence.exact_text: In August and September 2021, the relevant local governmental authorities deemed Jinmao PM in violation of the Pricing Law of the PRC by failing to charge end users electricity fees according to governmental pricing standard for certain projects under its management from May 2018 to April 2021, and therefore ordered Jinmao PM to rectify such non-compliance and imposed a total fine of RMB3.05 million on Jinmao PM. By the end of September 2021, Jinmao PM had rectified such non-compliance, including, among others, refunding and compensating for the additional electricity fees collected and strictly implementing the governmental pricing mechanism in the collection of electricity fees, and had paid the fine in full.
evidence.evidence_reason: The disclosed electricity-pricing fine was fully paid and rectified; it is quantified and did not remain an unresolved material regulatory matter.
